commit.message:
feat(TRA-4535): render-redeploy refuses a second commit advance into one freeze window (exit 10)

Board ruling A (TRA-4383, card c4dd383c) caps bqb1 at ONE deploy train per day through
2026-09-18. Nothing on the deploy path executed that ceiling, so it held only as prose: the
09-09 window carried 9 commit advances past every gate, and on 09-10 the stopgap EMBARGOES row
lost a race by 34s (committed 22:07:00Z; dep-dahik9m1 advanced b5c76cc1 -> 05be2d16 at 22:07:34Z
from a checkout that did not hold it).

The cadence gate counts COMMIT ADVANCES off Render's own deploy history for the current window
and refuses one more once the quota is reached, under a new exit code 10 with its own override
(--override-cadence="TRA-#### why", must name a ticket).

- Counted: a deploy whose commit differs from the previous counting deploy's. Failed/canceled
  deploys neither count nor move the baseline. In-flight deploys count. A same-SHA redeploy
  (env-apply) is never counted and never refused.
- Window: [D 20:00Z, D+1 20:00Z), half-open. This is deliberately wider than the ticket's
  [20:00Z, 13:25Z). The narrower shape leaves an RTH-override deploy, and any weekend-afternoon
  deploy, in no window at all.
- Fails closed: an unreadable history, one that does not reach back to a baseline, or a spent
  window with an unreadable live sha is BLIND and exits 10.
- Dated: active only inside a CADENCE_CEILINGS row. The first is 2026-09-08T18:50Z ->
  2026-09-19T04:00Z (TRA-4384, max 1), and the gate is inert outside it. Scoped to bqb1.

Controls (check:deploy-gates, 204/204):
- a REPLAY of bqb1's real Render history for 09-08..09-10: in the TRA-4535 table row 1 PROCEEDS
  and rows 2-9 REFUSE, and the window counts come out 5 / 9 / 2;
- one-variable pairs: same-SHA, BLIND, the half-open boundary, row edges, failed statuses,
  weekend and RTH-override;
- the shipped main() spawned against the read-only stub, which gained optional deploys/health
  keys.
Ten mutations of the gate, including deleting the call site, each turn the suite red.
check:arg-guard knows --override-cadence and refuses a misspelling of it.

A dry run against the live history on 2026-09-10T22:31Z: --commit=<tip> exits 10 with 2 advances
counted; --commit=<live 05be2d16> proceeds as SAME_SHA.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge PR #4 (TRA-4901/TRA-4737): midday news-catalyst refresh, with the health probe un-frozen

Adds the missing fourth news checkpoint (onMiddayNews, 12:00-12:30 ET) and
per-window cache keying so a midday sweep is a real vendor pull rather than a
replay of the 09:00 pool.

Includes the follow-up fix 4fcc3fce: widening the single-slot sweep cache into a
Map left the health probe resolving its window with [...values()].find(), which
returns the OLDEST entry from day 2 onward -- /api/health/news-catalyst-signals
froze on day 1 and a dead news feed read healthy:true. Two redundant guards (key
eviction at creation; probe takes the last match), each mutation-graded on its
own, plus three day-boundary regression cases that fail 3/3 against fee50d1e.

Authorised by board confirmation 7d5e38ad on TRA-4737 (accepted 2026-09-20T21:54:50Z).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
